limitations: Windows GPU allocation totals and engine video-memory monitors are not physical VRAM occupancy.
Three repeat visits per launch establish bounded observed residency, not an unlimited-duration leak proof.
Synthetic 170 km/h stress and GPU pass diagnostics are reported separately.
Standard second-seed visual/habitat controls retain the functional evidence; these timings cover the default Standard seed only.
The first constant-control forest attempt survived contacts and is excluded from matched acceptance. The surveyed-cell high-speed trace covered only 409 m and was rejected before FPS playback.

qualification: The requested grass measurement and scoped optimizations are complete. Both controls miss the whole-game frame-time goals; no complete-descent, display-latency or human/controller acceptance is claimed.

supplemental_stress.scope: 170 km/h benchmark driver with collision queries retained but responses suppressed. Not ordinary handling or FPS acceptance.

gpu_attribution.scope: One separate 15-second native diagnostic per control; trim 15 boundary frames at each end. Consecutive timestamps, no nested scope sums. Not acceptance timing or a pixel-overdraw count. FSR2 marker wraps the actual FSR 4.1.1 provider.

rendered.standard_scope: Bounded 1280x720 synthetic wind/bend/streaming sequence, separate from performance

placement_probe_ms.scope: 81 cells on the full Standard field in isolation, not rendered FPS

observations: All 36 ordinary trials are focused, source-stable, warm-cache and exact-state matches; ground/mineral grass is zero in every off control.

Forest on population is 8778 at start and 8081 at end; transition is 1541 then 3035; all controls retain 200000 physical trees and independent mineral collision and the same terrain checksums. On controls retain 496 global mineral-grass instances; these counts are not frustum-visible counts.
Ordinary ground residency is 261 cells with no pending/inflight work at each recorded endpoint, identically across the three visits per launch.
Measured process working sets are about 1.69-1.82 GiB. End-of-trial working set grows by roughly 1-6 MiB over three visits in both controls; no unlimited-duration leak claim is made.
Desktop ChatGPT and AMD recording-service activity is retained in telemetry, including a slow forest-off launch. Background variation limits precision; no adverse valid run was discarded.
Median forest main-thread grass streaming/submission is about 0.10 ms/frame; preparation remains roughly 8 ms per cell in workers instead of blocking a frame with up to three cells.
Whole-game targets are missed even with grass removed. Further general renderer optimization is outside this grass milestone.
